topics.title: Why Everyone Stopped Buying Crocs (and Then Didn't)
topics.angle: Open on a pair of Crocs. The craze to 2007 ($847.4M sales), the crash in 2008 (sales $721.6M, a $185.1M loss, staff cut from about 5,300 to 3,700, a going-concern warning in its own 10-K), and the comeback to about $4.04B in 2025. What changed: the same 'ugly' shoe sold as a canvas (charms, collaborations) instead of a fad. Chapter 1: one model, the Beach, in six colours, launched in 2002 for water sports; the Croslite formula kept as a trade secret.
